label: SCG I.22 both n.4 cases reject a dependently joined quiddity
meaning: Formalizes the whole two-case n.4 reply in the dependence sense PER_SE_NECESSARY_2, reusing the first-case premises of PR #1602 without its modal-to-intelligibility bridge. Non-transcription: the conclusion follows by a constructive case split over the OPEN premises and the definition. It rejects only a proposed quiddity whose joining has a source other than the esse; a joining with no source or sourced only in the esse is outside it. No premise or root obligation is discharged; attribution deferred.
